_doc: Outcome manifest for managed/scripts/outcome-reaper.py.
Copy this to <workspace>/ops/job-outcomes.json and replace the examples with
your own jobs. <workspace> is $OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE, or ~/clawd.
WHY THIS EXISTS, and why it is not a job-liveness check:
A scheduler tracks whether a job RAN. It reports green when the agent turn
completed, which it does even when the work did not happen. The failure this
catches is the expensive one: a dashboard reading all-green for weeks while a
job quietly delivers nothing, because nobody goes looking at a green board.
So track the ARTIFACT, not the job, and check it from outside the job.
THE RULE THAT MAKES THIS WORK: a no-op must still write a receipt. 'Nothing
to report' and 'I am broken' are otherwise the same observable, which is
silence. A job that legitimately has nothing to say must still touch its
artifact on the run that found nothing. Error paths should skip the write, so
a failed run reads as stale rather than fresh.
FIELDS
job        human name, matching the cron or script name where possible
artifact   path the job must keep fresh, relative to the workspace or absolute
maxAgeH    hours before staleness is a real problem. Be generous, and set it
to cover the longest LEGITIMATE gap: a weekday-only job needs 72
hours, not 30, or it false-alarms every Saturday. False alarms
train everyone to ignore this file, which is how the blind spot
comes back.
noOpWritesReceipt  does the job touch the artifact even when idle? Set it
honestly. false means a green result from this job proves nothing.
breaks     what is actually broken for the user when this goes stale. If you
cannot write that sentence, the check is not worth having.
note       optional; anything the person reading the alert at 2am needs
disabled   optional; true skips the entry without deleting the record of it

outcomes.breaks: the morning briefing stopped being delivered
daily notes stop being promoted into long-term memory, so the agent quietly forgets
the workspace is no longer backed up and nothing says so
incoming mail is not being triaged
outcomes.note: does not write on an empty inbox, so quiet and dead look identical. Fix the job, do not raise the budget.
